note: AP Style Date Formats provides two field formatters (timestamp_ap_style for datetime/timestamp/created/changed/published_at; daterange_ap_style for daterange/smartdate), the date_ap_style.formatter service (ApStyleDateFormatter::formatTimestamp/formatRange), and an ap_style Twig filter. Global defaults live in the date_ap_style.settings config (admin at /admin/config/regional/date-ap-style, permission 'administer ap style settings'); keys include always_display_year, use_today, cap_today, display_day, display_time, hide_date, time_before_date, display_noon_and_midnight, capitalize_noon_and_midnight, use_all_day, month_only, separator (to|endash|hyphen), timezone. Shipped defaults are all-false with separator=to and timezone=''. Medium cases write a distinctive value into date_ap_style.settings and read it back; hard cases build real state (enable always_display_year globally; assign the timestamp_ap_style formatter to a datetime field's view display) verified against live config. reset/cleanup restore the shipped defaults explicitly.

evals.prompt: In the date_ap_style Drupal module, what is the machine id of the field formatter that displays a datetime/timestamp field in AP style, and which field types can it be used on?
evals.expected_output: The formatter id is timestamp_ap_style (label 'AP Style'); it applies to datetime, timestamp, created, changed and published_at fields. (Date ranges use daterange_ap_style for daterange/smartdate.)

evals.prompt: Does date_ap_style offer a way to format a timestamp as AP style directly inside a Twig template? If so, what is it called and how is it used?
evals.expected_output: Yes — a Twig filter named ap_style: {{ timestamp|ap_style }} (with an optional options array, e.g. {{ timestamp|ap_style({display_time: true}) }}). It wraps ApStyleDateFormatter::formatTimestamp().

evals.prompt: Where are the site-wide default AP style date options stored in date_ap_style, at what admin path, and which permission controls that form?
evals.expected_output: Global defaults live in the date_ap_style.settings config object, edited at /admin/config/regional/date-ap-style (route date_ap_style.settings), gated by the 'administer ap style settings' permission. Formatter instances inherit these defaults and can override them per view display.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the global AP style date settings and state which date-range separator is currently configured.
evals.expected_output: date_ap_style.settings separator is 'endash' (the en dash). Read via `drush cget date_ap_style.settings separator`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the global AP style date settings and state the timezone override that is currently configured.
evals.expected_output: date_ap_style.settings timezone is 'America/Chicago'. Read via `drush cget date_ap_style.settings timezone`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, change the global AP Style date settings so that the year is always displayed, even for dates in the current year. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set date_ap_style.settings always_display_year to true, e.g. `drush cset date_ap_style.settings always_display_year 1 -y` or via the form at /admin/config/regional/date-ap-style. Verified: always_display_year === TRUE.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a Date/time field named field_apstyle_probe. Configure the Article default view display so this field is rendered with the AP Style date formatter. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the field_apstyle_probe component's formatter type to timestamp_ap_style (the module's AP Style formatter for datetime fields), e.g. on Manage display choose 'AP Style', or set the component type in config and save. Verified: component type === 'timestamp_ap_style'.
